description: Hey, I'm Mila and I wanted to do a game-simulator educative and logic.
summary:
THE LAST TELEMETRY is an interactive space mission simulator developed by NO SIGNAL for NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, in response to the “Build a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer” challenge.

Players take the role of a spacecraft crew member during a critical electrical system failure. Through a narrative-driven experience, they explore the spacecraft, investigate technical problems, manage essential resources, interact with crew members, and make decisions that influence the mission's outcome. The game includes a 2D exploration environment, a step-by-step electrical repair sequence, resource management mechanics, and multiple possible endings.

Our project addresses the challenge by transforming complex space mission scenarios into an accessible and engaging learning experience. It encourages players to develop problem-solving, critical thinking, teamwork, and decision-making skills while introducing them to the challenges of spacecraft operations.
details: The Last Telemetry is a simulator made for Junior students to improve their knowledge and practice in situations of pressure.
